newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA January commodity index mixed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA January commodity index mixed.

text.p: Commodity prices put in a mixed performance in January, according to the Commonwealth Bank of Australia's (CBA) commodity price index.
The index fell by 0.4 percent in U.S. dollar terms over the month in a period when the U.S. dollar rose by almost four percent against the Japanese yen and German mark, CBA said.
The index rose by 2.8 percent in January in statutory reserve deposit (SDR) terms.

Major influences were a four percent increase in aluminium prices, a 10.0 percent increase in nickel prices and a six percent increase in zinc prices, it said. Oil prices were down by six percent and gold prices by four percent.
Metals prices were stronger except for gold over the month, with the metals index up 1.6 percent in U.S. dollar terms.
The rural index rose by 0.2 percent in U.S. dollar terms.
